explanation: node->DispatchEvent(event) runs JavaScript which can remove the node from the DOM and trigger GC. Lines 8 and 16 then access node after it may have been freed.
element->RemoveChildFrames() can execute onunload scripts that remove the iframe element. element->ClearContentFrame() at line 9 then accesses freed memory.
child->UpdateStyle() can trigger observers that detach child from the tree. The loop increment child->nextElementSibling() then accesses freed memory.
target->DispatchEvent(event) allows JS to remove target from the document causing destruction. m_effect->ApplySample(target) at line 7 then uses freed memory.
delete box at line 8 frees child. child->HasLayer() at line 10 then dereferences the freed pointer.
obj->OnResize triggers plugin-internal events that can destroy the PluginObject. obj->NeedsRedraw() at line 6 then accesses freed memory.
context->ExecuteScript runs the timer JS callback which can call clearTimeout destroying this DOMTimer. Lines 5-7 then access this members on freed memory.
FreeObject(obj) at line 6 frees the heap object. obj->HasWeakReferences() at line 8 then dereferences freed memory.
DispatchEvent triggers JS change handler which can remove option from the DOM. option->IsDisabled() at line 5 then accesses freed memory.
Element::AttributeChanged(name) can trigger mutation observers that delete the proxy object. proxy->IsActive() at line 8 then dereferences freed memory.
ProcessEvents() triggers JS message handlers. A handler calling ws.close() and dropping all references frees this. m_state access at line 5 is then a UAF.
AdjustScrollbarsForLayout() fires scroll events. A script handler can destroy the scrollbar object. m_horizontalScrollbar->IsVisible() at line 6 then dereferences freed memory.
DetermineInsertionPoint() can trigger synchronous events that delete newChild. InsertBefore and UpdateLogicalWidth then dereference freed memory.
Setting m_fillGradient to nullptr drops the refcount to zero freeing currentGradient. OnDetachedFromContext() at line 6 then calls into freed memory.
DispatchEvent runs JS that can remove target from the DOM causing deallocation. target->IsInDocument() at line 9 then dereferences freed memory.
DispatchEvent fires the JS load handler which can nullify the XHR and trigger GC. m_responseType access at line 4 and CleanupNetworkResources at line 7 then use freed this.
m_callback->handleEvent runs JS which can call disconnect() and drop all references to this observer. m_isDisconnected access at line 7 is then a UAF.
UpdateAppearance() can fire layout events that deallocate range. range->StartOffset() at line 5 then dereferences freed memory.
DispatchEvent fires JS addcue handler which can remove the cue from the track. cue->StartTime() at line 5 then dereferences freed memory.
Invoke(time) calls the requestAnimationFrame JS callback which can cancel the animation and destroy this object. m_shouldRepeat and m_lastFrameTime accesses then use freed memory.
